tools.name: render_pdf
tools.description:
Render up to 256 KB of HTML to a PDF with WeasyPrint. Returns a download link.

Give the user the `download_url` so they can open the PDF. The link
works for 15 minutes; after that, render again. The result is
`{"download_url": "<link>", "pages": <page count>, "size_bytes": <PDF size>,
"expires_in_m

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "weasyprint" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: render_pdf · Private data: render_pdf · Public sink: render_pdf · Destructive: render_pdf.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: render_pdf · Private data: render_pdf · Public sink: render_pdf · Destructive: render_pdf

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
